# 4g-usb-phone-mcp

MCP server for controlling a Huawei Balong 4G USB modem (E3372/E8372) via its HTTP API.

## Links
- [Source](https://github.com/sandraschi/4g-usb-phone-mcp)
- [Full docs](llms-full.txt)

## Quick start
1. Plug in Huawei E3372/E8372 USB modem
2. `just serve` (stdio) or `$env:MCP_PORT=11072; just serve-http` (SSE)
3. Use `modem_phone(operation="status")` to check signal

## Tools
- `modem_phone` — portmanteau with operations: status, signal, sms_list, sms_send, sms_delete, reboot, net_mode
- `show_modem_health_card` — rich Prefab card with live modem status

## Env vars
- `BALONG_HOST` — modem IP (default 192.168.8.1)
- `BALONG_PORT` — HTTP port (default 80)
- `BALONG_TIMEOUT` — HTTP timeout seconds (default 5)

## Related fleet servers
- [telephony-mcp](https://github.com/sandraschi/telephony-mcp) — PSTN voice calls over your LTE link
- `sdr-mcp` (planned) — RF spectrum analysis with a $25 RTL-SDR, sees what the modem abstracts
